Confirming the AEGIS paper is real (rather than a possibly-fabricated blog summary) allowed adding vam_momentum_k50 as a disclosed step-1-only partial proxy, instead of dropping dir:volatility_gated_momentum_aegis entirely for unverified evidence.

The page discloses the platform's own current implementation as 37 (not a round 50 or 30) long positions, so momentum_concentrated_k37 uses k=37 rather than defaulting to T1's k=30, per the brief's own precedence rule (source k/h beats the T1 default).
